discoveredChildren.name: Reach Higher Montana Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: (50) $2,000 scholarships. High School Senior who will graduate from a Montana High School, completed the FAFSA, and will attend (at least half-time) an accredited Montana post-secondary institution/program.

discoveredChildren.name: Carl Valvoda Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: (1) $2,000 scholarship. Must complete the Reach Higher Montana Scholarship application and is serving or have served in the ROTC program or the U.S. Armed Forces.

discoveredChildren.name: Bridging the Gap Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: $1,000 for one or more recipients. Must complete the Reach Higher Montana Scholarship application, and will or have aged out of the Foster Care system.

discoveredChildren.name: Kelly Kuntz Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: $2,000 scholarship. Montana high school graduate in their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of post-secondary education, working towards a business-related degree.

discoveredChildren.name: Horse Creek Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: (6) $1,500 scholarships. High school seniors or college students who have/will graduate from a Montana High School, have/will complete the FAFSA by April 1, attend (at least half-time) ANY accredited post-secondary institution nationwide, pursuing a certificate/degree in a business-related field or has completed at least one Business/Finance related course in high school or college. Two scholarships given preference to graduates/residents of Beaverhead and Madison Counties.

discoveredChildren.name: Gilman Family Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: (2) $1,250 scholarships. Post-secondary students in their 2nd or later years of schooling, attending full-time, and pursuing a major or degree in the Trades, Agriculture, or Natural Resources related program of study. Applicants must have attended Sheridan or Twin Bridges High Schools.

discoveredChildren.name: Rotary of Helena Scholarship
discoveredChildren.fact: (1+) $1,500 scholarships. High School Seniors graduating from Helena area high schools (Capital HS, Helena HS, East Helena HS, & Project for Alternative Learning).

discoveredChildren.name: The Angel Fund Scholarship

discoveredChildren.name: Kid's Chance of Montana

discoveredChildren.name: Agri Industries
